title: Minimap
author: Rauno Freiberg

fresh_visual_review.method: Every native original frame inspected in12 ordered full-canvas contact sheets at300px wide; three native-resolution keys. No fps resampling.

recommendation: Clean drawable candidate. Local height wave travels along49 stationary vertical lines as pointer traverses and leaves/reenters; pure geometry, no source image dependency.

geometry.x_centers: 204.5 +18*i, i=0..48; each source tick occupies two integer pixel columns
geometry.confidence: Static anchors measured directly from native frame0. Tick heights change over time; x positions visibly remain fixed. Colors approximate because source is compressed.

observations.behavior: Static initial ticks and fixed red playhead. Black pointer enters from right.

Pointer traverses right to left across tick field. Nearby bars grow into a moving hump; adjacent bars briefly shorten into shallow troughs. Peaks lag/settle subtly after pointer movement. Five black accent ticks keep their color.
Pointer exits to left; expanded bars relax and shallow wave dissipates to baseline.
Pointer changes direction and reapproaches left edge; no red playhead motion.
Second traversal left to right, recreating moving hump and trailing/leading troughs. Near303height peaks strongly as pointer sits below the field.
Pointer leaves downward; height wave contracts back to baseline with settling. Pointer travels below field.
Pointer reenters near right-middle, generating another hump and holding briefly around same horizontal area.
Third traversal continues right-middle to left, then exits left.
Residual bump settles to baseline and pointer moves out of view.
Final static ticks and unchanged red playhead.

limits: Do not animate tick x positions or call this horizontal magnification: native keys confirm fixed18px spacing. Motion is height deformation.
No clicking, playback advancement, dragging or audio playback is shown; do not invent those actions as source behavior.
All traversals form one distinct example.
Individual X post URL not verified. Public author page/video are primary provenance; author X profile is included.
Reference originals/crops are local-analysis only; no source redistribution license identified.
